description: A 3HP mixer summing three signals, each with its own level knob

params.text: Sets the level of the signal at input a, following the square of the knob position
Sets the level of the signal at input b, following the square of the knob position
Sets the level of the signal at input c, following the square of the knob position

inputs.text: The first of the three signals summed
The second of the three signals summed
The third of the three signals summed

outputs.text: The three inputs summed, each at the square of its own knob position; where those gains come to more than 1 they divide the sum, holding the level roughly steady as channels are opened

menu: Additive Mix — sums the three signals as they are, dropping the division that otherwise holds the level roughly steady as channels are opened
